title: World of Tanks · Vault Extras
notes: Optional bonus list on top of the game's own achievements: medals, career milestones and mastery from your World of Tanks service record.
Read from Wargaming's official public API with a free application ID you add in Settings → World of Tanks. Vault never touches the game itself. Medals update within about 10 minutes of a battle.

testGuide.title: Add your details
testGuide.detail: Settings → World of Tanks: paste your application ID, type your player name, pick your region, Save.

testGuide.title: Turn on Vault Extras
testGuide.detail: Open World of Tanks in your library and press Turn on. Medals you already have unlock quietly.
